description: This file declares the ControlService class, which implements the IControlService interface for managing control connections and states within the Rialto server service. It includes methods for adding, removing, acknowledging controls, setting application state, and pinging clients. The class maintains internal state and dependencies such as factories and a control map.

classes.name: ControlService
classes.description: Implements control management functionalities for the Rialto server, handling control connections, application state, and heartbeat procedures.

methods.name: ControlService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ControlService with dependencies for control server internal factory and heartbeat procedure factory.

methods.name: addControl
methods.description: Adds a control client with a specified control ID.

methods.name: removeControl
methods.description: Removes a control client identified by control ID.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges a control message with a given control ID and message ID.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings a control client with a specified ID and acknowledgment sender.
